instruction: Dynamically set the video's audio volume in response to the ambient noise level in the room.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because VLC media player cannot detect or measure ambient room noise levels to automatically adjust audio volume. VLC lacks microphone access for environmental audio analysis and automatic volume adjustment based on external noise conditions.

llm_judge_reasons: Task correctly identified as infeasible - VLC does not support ambient noise detection or automatic volume adjustment based on environmental audio
